source_name_inventory.scope: Workspace top-level ordinary source filenames only; no recursion into staging

source_scope: Phase4 reference code; potentially relevant to aes_core/spi only among the six TRAIN circuits. Not an authenticated Phase2/3 producer.

static_findings.coarse_grid: Endpoint-dependent 5-percent checkpoints; HMF M checkpoint construction depends on per-H full-M output.
static_findings.refine: PASS/valid coarse candidates sorted by measured cycles, top-five regions and adaptive neighborhood/coordinate search.
static_findings.f_completion: May include coverage probe, full fallback, incremental scan, binary integer boundary and F-1 runs; final F result alone is not the whole search.
static_findings.cache: Existing output files plus marker may be reused; cache return lacks new wall time and measurement rows omit per-run wall time.
static_findings.plan: Records endpoint-derived plan, but no driver-source binding, candidate-parent decision ledger or freeze ACK.
static_findings.export_manifest: Hashes final export files, not a complete source/input/plan/driver-log invocation ledger.

adaptive_policy_boundary: Freeze prospective policy, domain constraints/generation rules, parameters, budgets and cache/accounting policy before relevant future outcomes; endpoint-dependent domain values and realized refinement points may depend on permitted past outcomes. Do not demand all realized future points fixed before all outcomes, or mistake present reference code for a historical freeze receipt.
source_code_review: Parent and metadata_history_scout independently inspected exact local reference code without import/execution; final publication review recorded separately.
next_dependency: Locate contemporaneous deployment/launch metadata binding executed driver SHA, command/job identity and output root for aes_core/spi. Reference filename or hash made now does not establish historical execution. Do not extend this Phase4 clue to Phase2/3.
